description_en: Sends a voice verification code or voice notification with variables to a phone number. A voice file or text-to-speech (TTS) template is supported
description_zh: 向指定号码发送语音验证码和带参数变量的语音通知，支持语音文件模板或文本转语音模板
kebab_example: aliyun dyvmsapi-intl voice-single-call --caller-id-number 85200000001 --called-number 85200000000 --tts-code 1001 --tts-param code_:_1234 --voice-code 1002 --play-times 2 --volume 100 --speed 0 --task-name '单呼任务名' --send-type 1 --timing-start 2022-05-01T08:00:00+08:00 --out-id 225220000 --country-id HK --region cn-hangzhou
name: VoiceSingleCall

parameters.help_en: The calling number. If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses a local random number as the display number. If you use a dedicated number for outbound calls, you must specify the purchased number. You can specify only one number. You can log on to the VMS console and go to the number management page to view the purchased phone numbers
parameters.help_zh: 主叫号码。 若您不填该参数，系统将会使用当地随机号码作为外显号码。 若您专属号码外呼，则必须传入已购买的号码，仅支持一个号码。您可以登录国际语音服务控制台，选择"号码管理"查看已购买的号码
parameters.name: caller_id_number

parameters.help_en: The phone number that receives the voice notification. You must add the country/region dialing code to the beginning of the phone number. Example: 85200\\00
parameters.help_zh: 接收语音通知的手机号码。 号码格式：国际码+号码： 示例：85200****00
parameters.name: called_number

parameters.help_en: The ID of the TTS template. You can log on to the VMS console and go to the TTS templates page to view the template ID. You must specify either TtsCode or VoiceCode. You can specify TtsCode to use the voice file as the call content, or you can specify VoiceCode to use preset text as the call content
parameters.help_zh: 文本转语音模板的语音 ID。 您可以登录国际语音服务控制台，选择"语音模板管理"-"文本转语音模板"，查看模板 ID。 此参数与 VoiceCode 二选一必填。分别代表使用语音文件作为呼叫内容呼叫或者使用固定模板文字作为呼叫内容
parameters.name: tts_code

parameters.help_en: The variables in the template, in the JSON format
parameters.help_zh: 模板中的变量参数，JSON 格式
parameters.name: tts_param

parameters.help_en: The ID of the voice file template. You can log on to the VMS console and go to the voice file templates page to view the template ID. You must specify either TtsCode or VoiceCode. You can specify TtsCode to use the voice file as the call content, or you can specify VoiceCode to use preset text as the call content
parameters.help_zh: 语音文件的模板 ID。 您可以登录国际语音服务控制台，选择"语音模板管理"-"语音文件"，查看模板 ID。 此参数与 TtsCode 二选一必填。分别代表使用语音文件作为呼叫内容呼叫或者使用固定模板文字作为呼叫内容
parameters.name: voice_code

parameters.help_en: The number of times the voice notification is played in the call. Valid values: 1 to 3. Default value: 3
parameters.help_zh: 一通电话内语音通知内容的播放次数。取值范围：1~3，默认取值 3
parameters.name: play_times

parameters.help_en: The playback volume of the voice notification. Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 语音通知的播放音量。取值范围：0~100，默认取值 100
parameters.name: volume

parameters.help_en: The playback speed. Valid values: -500 to 500
parameters.name: speed

parameters.help_en: The delivery type. Valid values: 1 and 2. 1: immediately delivers the task. 2: delivers the task at a scheduled time. If you set this parameter to 2, you must specify TimingStart
parameters.help_zh: 发送类型：取值[1,2]。 1： 立即开始发送任务，不等待。 2： 定时开始发送任务。如果传该类型，TimingStart 为必选字段
parameters.name: send_type

parameters.help_en: The time when the task is scheduled to be delivered
parameters.name: timing_start

parameters.help_en: The ID reserved for the caller. This ID is returned to the caller in a receipt message. The value must be a string that is 1 to 15 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 预留给调用方使用的 ID，最终会通过在回执消息中将此 ID 带回给调用方。 字符串类型，长度为 1~15 个字节
parameters.name: out_id

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial

Code.description_en: The error code. A value of OK indicates that the request was successful. For information about other error codes, see Error codes
Code.description_zh: 请求状态码。 返回 SUCCESS 代表请求成功。 其他错误码，请参见 API 错误码

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values: true and false
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功，成功：true，失败：false
